summary: The LLM landscape today is dominated by a handful of frontier vendors (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) whose models are consumed both via direct APIs and increasingly through enterprise cloud aggregators like AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, and IBM watsonx. Open-weights models from Meta, DeepSeek, Mistral, and Alibaba (Qwen) maintain massive developer adoption through HuggingFace downloads and self-hosting. Note: several model names appearing in the live research data (e.g. 'GPT-6', 'DeepSeek V3.2', 'Gemini 3.1 Flash') could not be reliably confirmed as the exact official current naming, so this list conservatively uses only well-established, confirmable model names.

models.name: GPT-4o
models.popularity_notes: Consistently the most-used LLM by API call volume and developer surveys, with broad availability through Azure OpenAI Service expanding its enterprise reach dramatically.
models.best_for: General-purpose production applications requiring multimodal input and reliable performance

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.popularity_notes: Matches Opus-level performance at Sonnet pricing per research data, and is widely available through AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and direct API, driving heavy enterprise and coding adoption.
models.best_for: Coding assistants and multi-step agentic enterprise workflows

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.popularity_notes: Google's flagship reasoning model with deep integration into Google Vertex AI and Workspace, giving it massive enterprise aggregator reach.
models.best_for: Long-context document analysis and enterprise applications on Google Cloud

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.popularity_notes: High-volume, low-cost model with a large context window, widely adopted for cost-sensitive production workloads via Vertex AI.

models.name: DeepSeek R1
models.popularity_notes: Open-weights reasoning model with explosive HuggingFace download numbers and strong price-performance, widely self-hosted and offered via cloud providers.
strengths: Strong reasoning at very low cost
models.best_for: Cost-efficient reasoning tasks and self-hosted deployments

models.name: DeepSeek V3
models.popularity_notes: Research notes DeepSeek delivers roughly 90% of frontier performance at a fraction of the cost, driving huge open-weights adoption via HuggingFace and aggregators.
models.best_for: Budget-conscious general-purpose text generation at scale

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B
models.popularity_notes: One of the most downloaded open-weights models on HuggingFace and available through AWS Bedrock, Azure, and IBM watsonx, making it a default for enterprise self-hosting.

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.popularity_notes: Anthropic's fast, low-cost tier, widely used for high-volume tasks and available across Bedrock and Vertex AI aggregators.
strengths: Good coding capability for its tier
models.best_for: High-volume, latency-sensitive tasks needing Claude-quality output

models.name: Mistral Large 2
models.popularity_notes: Mistral's flagship model with strong European enterprise adoption and availability via Azure, AWS Bedrock, and Vertex AI.

models.name: Qwen3-235B-A22B
models.popularity_notes: Top-performing open-weights MoE model with rapidly growing HuggingFace downloads, especially popular in Asia and among the self-hosting community.
models.best_for: Open-weights deployments requiring frontier-level capability at low cost
